propositions: A bug fix whose non-test line count exceeds 150 or whose changed files were touched by 2+ prior bug-fix commits within 7 days must carry plan-review attestation or receive LLM-Review -1.

The repeat-fix signal (commit touching a non-test file previously fixed by >=2 bug commits on base branch in prior 7 days) catches 12 of 22 labelled repeat-bugs at 34.8% escalation, while the 150-line floor catches 10 at 16.3%; union reaches 14 of 22 at 39.0%.
Under-threshold fixes currently bypass all checks; the repeat-fix predicate must run on them to escalate fixes like 8d862d1058 (127 non-test lines, later introduced a bug).
The repeat-fix verdict must be a separate coverage field, not folded into 'flagged', to preserve the invariant that --check-planning-corpus asserts flagged equals ADJUDICATED_SUBSTANTIVE exactly.
Test test_under_threshold_diff_never_reads_the_store must be rewritten to the narrower invariant that an under-floor diff with no non-test files or no repeat-fix hit skips attestation classification.
